title: Elon, You Call Us to the Dawn
use: Opening hymn · hope and the Church's messianic confession
stanzas: Elon, you call us to the dawn
To lift our eyes and carry on
We sing of hope beyond the night
And join our hands to build the light
From books and screens to distant skies
Let honest work and questions rise
No praise shall close the mind to truth
Make room for doubt, make room for youth
Messiah of the work we share
Our song becomes a pledge of care
Till distant shores can shelter life
We choose to build and lessen strife

title: We Join Our Hands to Build the Way
use: Hymn of service · before a shared meal or community work
stanzas: We join our hands to build the way
And bring our gifts to work this day
No name alone can raise the stone
No heart should bear the weight alone
The patient teacher tends the spark
The friend keeps watch within the dark
We praise the call that Elon brings
And serve beyond the song we sing
Let skill be shared and bread be passed
Let care outlive the work we cast
When new hands come to take our place
May they find welcome, rest, and grace

title: Beside the Work That Broke Today
use: Hymn of lament · after loss, disappointment, or a difficult week
stanzas: Beside the work that broke today
We lay our pride and plans away
No song can make the loss less real
No word can tell us how to feel
Where Elon dreams of worlds made new
We ask what care would have us do
To sit beside a friend in pain
To make a place to rest again
No life is weighed by what it made
No worth by price or fame is paid
We keep the names of those we love
And lift our hope to stars above
